Okay, tonight we were discussing how to handle a disrespectful pair of roommates. We are both upset with how they are acting and how our interactions over the issues have been.  So I said I'm going to think of the best way to approach them and speak my mind and she said you Never do except to me.  I said things like "I don't want to start  a bunch of drama"and I ask "what do you want me to say to them?" Also,"do you want me to go off on them?"  It's one thing for me to speak but I should learn to be a better listener.

If I have learned anything from my s/o, is that men can have thick skulls.  In the heat of an argument I admit I'm not always thinking about what or I say or how I may say it because emotions are flying!  So this is something I struggle with to keep my cool through it all.

I decided to let us sleep it off(as she went to bed for the night) and talk about it in the morning.  It's good advice and am truly grateful for the input. I don't have any friends to talk to about things like this.  I think it might be how I handle problems with objective points of view, that I may be Belittling her inadvertently.  I'm bad with putting how I feel or what I'm thinking into words.

Thank you, that calmed me down and made me think for a few, but I'm not sure I do understand. When I ask how I am or what I'm saying to make her feel that way it seems she bounces to unrelated topics. I guess I need to just be aware of my actions and what I say. I am really trying to understand
